model.ecommerce.dim_customers.name: dim_customers
model.ecommerce.dim_customers.description: One row per customer with order history and lifetime value. Used by marketing and finance dashboards.
model.ecommerce.dim_customers.raw_code:
with customers as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_customers') }}

),

orders as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}

),

payments as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_payments') }}

),

customer_orders as (

    select
        customer_id,
        min(order_date) as first_order_date,
        max(order_date) as most_recent_order_date,
        count(order_id) as number_of_orders
    from orders
    group by customer_id

),

customer_payments as (

    select
        orders.customer_id,
        sum(payments.amount) as lifetime_value
    from payments
    inner join orders on payments.order_id = orders.order_id
    where orders.status != 'cancelled'
    group by orders.customer_id

),

final as (

    select
        customers.customer_id,
        customers.first_name,
        customers.last_name,
        customers.email,
        customers.country_code,
        customers.created_at,
        customer_orders.first_order_date,
        customer_orders.most_recent_order_date,
        coalesce(customer_orders.number_of_orders, 0) as number_of_orders,
        coalesce(customer_payments.lifetime_value, 0) as lifetime_value
    from customers
    left join customer_orders on customers.customer_id = customer_orders.customer_id
    left join customer_payments on customers.customer_id = customer_payments.customer_id

)

select * from final

model.ecommerce.fct_orders.name: fct_orders
model.ecommerce.fct_orders.description: One row per order with payment amounts pivoted by method. Grain must match stg_orders (one row per order).
model.ecommerce.fct_orders.raw_code:
with orders as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}

),

payments as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_payments') }}

),

order_payments as (

    select
        order_id,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'credit_card' then amount else 0 end) as credit_card_amount,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'bank_transfer' then amount else 0 end) as bank_transfer_amount,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'voucher' then amount else 0 end) as voucher_amount,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'gift_card' then amount else 0 end) as gift_card_amount,
        sum(amount) as total_amount
    from payments
    group by order_id

),

final as (

    select
        orders.order_id,
        orders.customer_id,
        orders.order_date,
        orders.status,
        coalesce(order_payments.credit_card_amount, 0) as credit_card_amount,
        coalesce(order_payments.bank_transfer_amount, 0) as bank_transfer_amount,
        coalesce(order_payments.voucher_amount, 0) as voucher_amount,
        coalesce(order_payments.gift_card_amount, 0) as gift_card_amount,
        coalesce(order_payments.total_amount, 0) as amount
    from orders
    left join order_payments on orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id

)

select * from final

test.ecommerce.null_rate_below_stg_custo.name: null_rate_below_stg_customers_email__0_05
test.ecommerce.null_rate_below_stg_custo.compiled_code:
with stats as (
    select
        count(*) as total_rows,
        sum(case when email is null then 1 else 0 end) as null_rows
    from "ecommerce"."main"."stg_customers"
)

select
    total_rows,
    null_rows,
    null_rows * 1.0 / nullif(total_rows, 0) as null_rate
from stats
where null_rows * 1.0 / nullif(total_rows, 0) > 0.05

test.ecommerce.equal_row_count_fct_order.compiled_code:
with model_rows as (
    select count(*) as n_rows from "ecommerce"."main"."fct_orders"
),

compare_rows as (
    select count(*) as n_rows from "ecommerce"."main"."stg_orders"
)

select
    model_rows.n_rows as model_rows,
    compare_rows.n_rows as compare_model_rows
from model_rows
cross join compare_rows
where model_rows.n_rows != compare_rows.n_rows

source.ecommerce.raw.raw_customers.name: raw_customers
source.ecommerce.raw.raw_customers.description: One row per customer account, extracted from the CRM.

columns.customer_id: CRM primary key of the customer (integer).
columns.email: Customer email address as entered in the CRM.
columns.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the customer's billing address.
columns.created_at: UTC timestamp when the account was created in the CRM.
columns.loaded_at: UTC timestamp when the ingestion job wrote the row.

source.ecommerce.raw.raw_orders.name: raw_orders
source.ecommerce.raw.raw_orders.description: One row per order placed in the web shop.

columns.order_id: Shop primary key of the order (integer).
columns.customer_id: CRM customer_id of the customer who placed the order.
columns.order_date: Date the order was placed (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD).
columns.status: Order lifecycle status: placed, shipped, completed or cancelled.
columns.loaded_at: UTC timestamp when the ingestion job wrote the row.

source.ecommerce.raw.raw_payments.name: raw_payments
source.ecommerce.raw.raw_payments.description: One row per payment taken by the payment provider. Split payments produce several rows per order.

columns.order_id: Shop order_id the payment belongs to.
columns.payment_method: Payment method: credit_card, bank_transfer, voucher or gift_card.
columns.loaded_at: UTC timestamp when the ingestion job wrote the row.
